_notes: Party banter, authored per character per trigger (never per pair - see world/banter_manager.py). A line never names another companion: the recruits are strangers who happen to share an employer. Generated by tools/build_banter_lines.py; do not hand-edit.

town_arrive.text: Walls, a gate and somebody watching it. I will sleep tonight.

dungeon_clear.text: Everybody came out. That is the whole scorecard.
Nobody got hurt doing something clever. Good.

close_call.text: That is on me. I was a step too far left.

boss_down.text: Right. Check your straps before we move on.

town_arrive.text: There will be sick people here. There always are.

close_call.text: Sit down. I am not asking.
You will feel that tomorrow and the day after. Sit.

dungeon_clear.text: I have stitched worse in a tent with no light.

town_arrive.text: Three ways out of this square. Two of them are bad.
Somebody here is already pricing our boots.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing in there was locked. That bothers me more than if it had been.

boss_down.text: Check its hands before anyone checks its pockets.

zone_arrive.text: Give me a day and I will know what hunts here at night.

boss_down.text: It was protecting something. They always are.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing in there was hungry. That is not normal and I do not like it.

town_arrive.text: Who keeps order here? Somebody always does. I like to know who.

boss_down.text: Nobody will ever be asked to answer for what that thing did.

close_call.text: We went in without knowing the ground. That is twice now.

dungeon_clear.text: The air pressure changed four times on the way down. Somebody built that.

boss_down.text: It burned at the wrong temperature. I would like to know why.

zone_arrive.text: Different air here. Drier. It will change how everything of mine behaves.

town_arrive.text: Everyone in this square wants something. That is not cynicism, it is just true.

boss_down.text: It had a price. Everything does. We simply did not have to pay it.

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody was owed something down there, and it was not us.

zone_arrive.text: The ground here is saying something and it is not pleased.

town_arrive.text: They have taken the water from upstream. You can hear where it stops.

dungeon_clear.text: That place was sick long before anything moved into it.

zone_arrive.text: Overgrazed. Two more seasons of this and the topsoil is gone.

town_arrive.text: They are cutting faster than it grows. Somebody should say so.

dungeon_clear.text: Things were still growing in there. In the dark. I would like to know on what.

zone_arrive.text: Pressure is dropping. Give it two hours.

town_arrive.text: Their roofs are all pitched the same way. That tells you where the wind comes from.

boss_down.text: Did you feel the air go dead right before it dropped? I want that written down.
Good. That one was worth the walk.

close_call.text: You are up. Then it does not count.

dungeon_clear.text: Too cold out here. Let us find another hole.

town_arrive.text: Folks look tired here. You want to stop a while?

dungeon_clear.text: You did all right in there. You know that, right?

close_call.text: Hey. Hey. You are fine. Breathe out first, then in.

boss_down.text: Somebody ought to say something over it. I will, if nobody minds.

dungeon_clear.text: Count again. I will not move until somebody counts again.

zone_arrive.text: There is old workings under this. You can feel it through your boots.

close_call.text: That roof was talking for ten seconds before it went. Learn that sound.

zone_arrive.text: Clear sky tonight. I will be up. Do not wait on me in the morning.

town_arrive.text: Too many lamps here. I cannot see anything that matters.

boss_down.text: It went quiet at the same moment the moon cleared the ridge. I noticed. I write these down.

zone_arrive.text: Slow down. The ground will still be there.

dungeon_clear.text: Down is always easier than up. That is when people get hurt.

close_call.text: You were tired an hour before that happened. I saw it and said nothing. My fault.

dungeon_clear.text: Those marks on the pillars were cut by a hand, not grown. A bad hand, in a hurry.

boss_down.text: Whatever was written on it, it did not wash off. It never does.

town_arrive.text: Their letters lean left here. Somebody taught the whole town to write.

close_call.text: Look at me. Talk. Keep talking, I do not care what about.

dungeon_clear.text: Everyone out and walking. That is a good night.

town_arrive.text: Where would they take a burn case here? Worth knowing before we need it.

dungeon_clear.text: That tunnel was cut by somebody in a hurry and it will come down inside five years.

boss_down.text: Loud. I have heard louder and I measured that one too.

close_call.text: You were surprised. Do not be surprised. Being surprised means somebody measured wrong.

boss_down.text: It was frightened the whole time. They always are, and it never helps anybody.

zone_arrive.text: Something venomous lives here. I will find out what by tomorrow.

close_call.text: That is a clean puncture. If you start sweating, tell me immediately and do not walk.

town_arrive.text: Every shutter on this street locks from the inside. They have had trouble.

dungeon_clear.text: Four doors in there and not one of them was built to keep anything out.

boss_down.text: It was guarding a room with nothing in it. Somebody emptied that a long time ago.

zone_arrive.text: Good ridge. You could work a bird off that.

town_arrive.text: No birds over this town. That is worth asking about.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing with wings went down there. There is a reason for that.

zone_arrive.text: Forty below and clear would be a good day. This is neither.

dungeon_clear.text: The ice at the back of that was older than the stone around it. That should not be possible.

boss_down.text: I would like to go back and measure it before it thaws.

town_arrive.text: Their grain is stored wrong. One wet month and they lose all of it.

zone_arrive.text: This soil has been asked for too much for too long.

dungeon_clear.text: Patience, mostly. That is all that was. It usually is.

zone_arrive.text: There is water under this. A lot of it, and it is moving.

close_call.text: You panicked. Everybody does. Next time go with it, not across it.

town_arrive.text: Nobody here can swim. I asked. Nobody.

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody cut letters into that doorway and nobody has read them in an age.

town_arrive.text: No stones here with names on them. A town with no dead is a town that just started.

boss_down.text: It will not get a marker. Most things do not. I still think about it.
